title: Shadow pipeline & calibration orchestration for INT8 weight-only GPTQ/AWQ: automated regression, telemetry, and rollback playbook
creator: Aisha Patel
description:
Context: We need a reproducible, automated shadow/ regression pipeline that validates INT8 weight-only profiles produced by GPTQ and AWQ against our golden quality baselines before they are allowed to be served. Existing calibration runs are ad-hoc and often miss low-probability failure modes at scale. This ticket implements an orchestration layer that runs calibration->profile generation->shadow inference->automated analysis->rollback recommendation as a single CI-enabled flow.

Goals: (1) Prevent silent quality regressions from new quant profiles; (2) Provide deterministic replay and evidence for rollbacks; (3) Reduce manual review load by surfacing prioritized failing prompts and concise delta metrics; (4) Integrate with canary rollout and automatic fallback in the serving control plane.

Scope: Build the harness and dashboards for nightly and pull-request-level checks, integrate calibration snapshotting and reproducible profile artifacts, add chaos tests (noise injection, kernel swap), and wire telemetry alerts that can trigger automated mitigations or block merges.
acceptance_criteria: A reproducible pipeline job 'int8-shadow-regression' exists in CI that takes a model + profile artifact and runs end-to-end comparisons against the golden seed ensemble
The pipeline publishes a single JSON report with numeric deltas (perplexity, cumulative logprob delta, top-1 token drift) and a ranked list of 20 highest-impact prompts with diffs
Automated decision rule implemented: if weighted quality degradation > 0.75% across golden dataset or > 2% regression on any high-priority prompt, the profile is marked 'fail' and cannot be promoted
Nightly run coverage includes at least three representative sequence lengths (64, 512, 2048) and both GPTQ and AWQ variants across 3 hardware kernels
Runbook documents for investigators and automated rollback actions are linked from the CI report
Telemetry signals are emitted to the console dashboard (int8.delta.q, int8.golden_answer_delta, int8.regression_flag) and wired to alerting
test_matrix: Models: small/medium/large family representatives (e.g., rdx-small, rdx-base, rdx-large) — include at least one ~30B model
Quant methods: GPTQ (per-channel) and AWQ (per-tensor) with weight-only profiles
Hardware kernels: cuda-cublas, cutlass-fused, fallback-vulkan (where available)
Calibration modes: snapshot-playback (deterministic), adaptive-sweep (exploratory), and shadow-replay (production trace)
milestones: 2025-02-19: Prototype CI job that runs profile application + inference on a single model/seqlen and produces JSON metrics
2025-02-26: Add golden-seed ensemble and ranked prompt diffs; implement basic 'fail' decision rule
2025-03-04: Integrate telemetry emission and dashboard widgets; wire alerting to SRE channel
2025-03-11: Add chaos kernels swap and noise injection; expand coverage to 3 hardware kernels
2025-03-18: Canary integration with serving policy (auto-fallback) and final runbook approval
rollback_criteria: Weighted quality degradation over golden ensemble > 0.75% (primary) => block promotion and auto-tag profile for rollback
Any single high-priority prompt with regression > 2% (or semantic answer changed) => immediate fail
Kernel swap leads to >3x increase in topk token-diff count => mark runtime-incompatible and fail
If telemetry shows sustained failure rate >5% for 1h on canary traffic => trigger automatic fallback to prior profile and page oncall
progress_updates: 2025-02-14: Spike complete — prototype harness can apply GPTQ profile and run 100 prompts locally against rdx-base; observed mean perplexity delta 0.3%
2025-02-18: Integrated golden seed ensemble (10k prompts). Initial nightly run shows two high-impact prompts with semantic drift under AWQ; flagged for follow-up evaluation
2025-02-25: Added deterministic calib-snapshot playback; fixed nondeterminism in RNG seeding across kernel implementations
2025-03-01: Telemetry emission implemented; console dashboard draft available. Working on SLO guard thresholds with SRE
2025-03-03: Chaos kernel-swap test added to CI matrix; discovered a numerical edge-case in cutlass-fused kernel — created ENG-908001 to track kernel fix
comments: PM (Jorge): prioritize rdx-large coverage for customer-facing models — customers reported subtle answer shifts after AWQ runs.
Design (Maya): dashboard needs 'blame' links to the exact calibration snapshot and PR that produced the profile.
SRE (Nina): SLO guard thresholds look reasonable; suggest a temporary alert for 3 consecutive nightly failures before auto-blocking promotions.
Infra (Hiro): ensure artifacts are stored with immutable hashes and signed metadata so we can audit and replay exact binaries and kernel build flags.
notes: We intentionally bias the decision rule to be conservative for customer-critical models (high recall for regressions). For internal low-risk models we can relax thresholds in a config map.
Consider later extension to include FP8 comparative path and mixed-precision backstop (if INT8 fails, try FP8 fallback)
Keep golden ensemble small but representative to keep CI latency < 60m for PR-level runs; use full 10k ensemble for nightly expanded runs.
